description:
Upload an INVOICE or RECEIPT (PDF, image, or .zip of them) for analysis.
``file_base64`` is the file's raw bytes, base64-encoded. ``direction`` is
``payable`` (incoming supplier invoice) or ``receivable`` (outgoing).
Creates Item(s) and queues extraction.

This door is invoices-only: it never routes a file onward by type, so a
bank statement, a journal export or a balance sheet sent here is analysed
and then just sits as a document. For anything that is not an invoice — or
when you are not sure what the file is — use ``upload_intake``.
name: upload_document
